exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Target your latissimus dorsi with this effective back exercise using a cable machine.
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine with knees secured under pads
Grasp the bar with wide overhand grip
Pull the bar down to your upper chest
Squeeze your lats at the bottom

exercises.name: Seated Rowing
exercises.description: Build a strong back with this seated rowing exercise targeting the middle trapezius and rhomboids.
instructions: Sit on the rowing machine with feet secured
Grasp the handle with both hands
Pull the handle to your lower chest
Return to starting position with control
